$comment: Per-suite wall-clock cost (ms) of the general-server vitest lane, used by scripts/general-server-shard.mjs to balance suites across the CI shard matrix (longest-processing-time-first). The cost of a suite is the gap between consecutive suite completion lines in the job log (import + collect + tests), because the lane runs suites serially; with several runs it is the mean over the runs. Regenerate with scripts/myrmidon/ci/shard-durations-from-logs.mjs from the logs of the last green main runs. Suites missing here get the median weight, so small drift is harmless; the shard test fails when coverage of the current suite set drops too low.
